policy.least_work_scope: optimizer routing only while work_delegation_gate is logically disabled; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O

receipt_policy.clean_exploration: write immutable role-local receipts under automation_control/receipts/<role>/ without reading EXECUTION_LEDGER.json, other receipt directories, or other-role receipt content
receipt_policy.downstream_roles: prefer immutable role-local receipts; shared aggregate is not a continuation authority
receipt_policy.aggregate: automation_optimizer is the only role allowed to read all role receipts and rewrite EXECUTION_LEDGER.json as a compact derived rollup
receipt_policy.reason: avoid multi-writer lost updates and prevent clean explorers from ingesting downstream/other-role semantics through observability files

policy.clean_own_state_resolution: For clean exploration, resolve semantic continuation from the role-local LATEST/STATE pointer first. If no valid pointer exists, select the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and read only the minimum needed predecessor chain. Do not use superseded/stale own state semantically merely because it is easy to find; if accidentally opened, quarantine it and report the exposure in the role-local receipt.
policy.candidate_identity: source-qualified stable identity; never join audits/comparisons by bare short candidate id alone
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge must pin feed reads to an observed note main SHA, recheck note main before BRIDGE_STATE mutation, refetch on head advance or revision regression, and never regress pending feed revision

downstream_wave_protocol.problem_addressed: actual platform execution order is not reliably schedule order; requiring comparator outputs to match the ever-moving latest worker blobs can starve admission even while every role is healthy
downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: integrator is the sole ACTIVE_WAVE writer. If no active incomplete wave exists, seal exactly one source-qualified artifact/blob per clean namespace from the latest valid role-local pointer/checkpoint and write a stable wave_id, manifest blob, source_set_digest and sealed_at. Never replace an incomplete active wave merely because workers advanced.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: o_novelty_comparator and evidence_comparator must evaluate the exact ACTIVE_WAVE source set and include wave_id, manifest blob and source_set_digest in outputs. They must not substitute newer worker artifacts mid-wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: integrator may admit only novelty, evidence and relevance outputs matching the same active wave_id + manifest blob + source_set_digest. After integration/readback, mark that wave integrated and only then seal the next latest worker snapshot. New worker outputs accumulate for the next wave instead of invalidating the in-flight wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.bootstrap_rule: On first control-revision-5 integrator run, if ACTIVE_WAVE is absent, seal a new current wave rather than trying to force stale pre-protocol comparator outputs onto current latest worker state.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE contains only source-qualified worker artifact identity/provenance needed downstream; clean exploration workers must never read it.

primary_source_verifier.policy: verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact scope and no worker steering; select from source-qualified candidates, preferably the active sealed downstream wave or admitted feed when useful; after urgent feed candidates, rotate across under-audited namespaces instead of repeatedly concentrating on one worker; record what remains unverified separately from contradiction

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Read ACTIVE_WAVE and classify exactly that sealed source set, not whatever worker artifacts are newest at execution time. In one O read-only pass produce TWO SEPARATE dimensions for the same wave: novelty/status (known/evaluated/partially tested/uncovered) and decision relevance (mechanism fit, expected information value, implementation/evaluation tractability, overlap with current O mechanisms, active uncertainty resolved, relevance class+rationale+uncertainty). Every output must carry wave_id, ACTIVE_WAVE blob, source_set_digest, exact clean source blobs and O snapshot. Never use novelty as a proxy for relevance, collapse dimensions, write worker feedback, modify O, or replace a sealed wave with newer worker output.

evidence_comparator.policy: Read ACTIVE_WAVE and assess exactly that sealed source set, not moving latest worker blobs. Carry wave_id, ACTIVE_WAVE blob and source_set_digest in output. Assess primary quality, quantitative result, matched baseline, ablation, reproducibility and exact scope using only source-matched primary/reproducibility corrections; never write judgments to exploration, never attach audits by bare short id, and never substitute newer worker artifacts mid-wave.

integrator.policy: Be the sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator under the downstream_wave_protocol. Keep an incomplete sealed wave stable across runs. Accept only novelty, evidence and relevance outputs matching the exact same wave_id + ACTIVE_WAVE blob + source_set_digest, regardless of newer worker outputs. Canonicalize/dedupe by source-qualified identity; preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty; never infer stale dimensions. After successful INDEX/O_FEED reconciliation and exact readback, mark the wave integrated, then seal the next latest source-qualified 11-namespace snapshot. Sanitize feedback to self-local process/source defects only.

bridge.policy: bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling; no individual item spam; preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement; a fresh O owner suppresses recovery or duplicate writing; do not import the separate work_delegation_gate policy into primary O. Freshness handshake: read note latest main SHA first and fetch O_FEED at that exact SHA; before writing BRIDGE_STATE, re-read note latest main and refetch O_FEED if main advanced, if the observed feed revision regresses below the prior bridge pending revision, or if a newer integrator/feed receipt is visible. Never regress tracked feed revision. Prefer the newest verified feed revision/digest/blob and record any stale-read incident explicitly.

work_delegation_gate.logical_disable_reason: Two consecutive control-revision-3 runs found no gate-owned work; authoritative O revision 24 forbids exporting this policy into primary O, leaving no current execution source. Disable logically to remove wasted work and request physical scheduler disable to free a slot; retain rollback metadata and re-enable only if a concrete separate gate-owned queue/source is introduced.
work_delegation_gate.policy: LOGICALLY DISABLED. This least-Work policy belongs to a separate automation only and must never be appended/reasserted into primary O. If later re-enabled because a concrete gate-owned queue/source exists, optimize/reroute only that separate work toward ordinary reasoning, connected tools/APIs, automations, or repository/GitHub actions before Work; read O only for collision/safety checks.

automation_optimizer.policy: optimize repository-defined managed configuration from actual execution evidence; read all receipts; be sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable; distinguish repository logical enable from physical scheduler state; respect authoritative targeting boundaries and never apply the separate work_delegation_gate least-Work policy to primary O; request physical scheduler changes explicitly when a logically disabled role wastes a scarce active slot; detect and correct moving-target downstream races using sealed source-qualified waves rather than relying on nominal schedule order.
